# `tab_width`

Columns a tab occupies when measuring line width.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `<integer>` | Any integer. |

**Default:** `4`

## Examples

*This option accepts a freeform value. No canned example is generated.*

```ini
tab_width = <value>
```
